summary.text: Dan Hunt is a Democratic state representative from the 13th Suffolk District who has held the seat since April 16, 2014 and is on the ballot for re-election on November 3, 2026.

paragraphs.text: Daniel Hunt assumed office on April 16, 2014, and in the 2025-2026 session he chairs the Election Laws Joint Committee.
